title: Geometric Saturation of the Scale Function in Black-Bounce Spacetimes: Spherical, Planar, and Hyperbolic Transverse Sections
summary: We present a new construction for black-bounce spacetimes based on a deformation of the scale function that acts as a geometric saturation rather than introducing a prescribed constant minimal length, as in conventional black-bounce models. This function encodes the gravitational information of the underlying vacuum counterpart, keeping the geometric quantities of the deformed metric finite in the short-distance region where tidal forces and curvature invariants of the vacuum geometry diverge.
